Name: Escape from Joja Redux
Author: Pandappuccino
Description:
So the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10898]Escape from Joja[/url] mod is fairly old but still functioning. This is just my attempt at simplifying the mod to remove dependencies on JsonAssets and Mail Framework Mod, and a little bit of practice for making mods.

You've left your old life and job behind to start anew in Stardew Valley, and for your time with the company, Joja Corporation has issued you a severance package! Unfortunately, their severance package is just microshares worth 0.001% shareholder value of the company, but some people pay a pretty good sum just to say they're a shareholder, and lucky for you, your shipping bin seems to have a nice space to dump the share certificates...

The default configuration delivers the letter on [b]Spring 7[/b], containing [b]10[/b] of a new sale-only item, Joja Stock Certificate. These certificates can't be gifted to others, but can be sold for 2,500 gold each (so this is a free 25k delivered directly to your mailbox), and thankfully you also won't drop them when you die. There's configuration options to determine what season you'll receive the letter with your severance package, as well as how many shares you get--you can keep it low, or claim you were a big-wig and got a ton of shares! There's even a little flavor text configuration purely for aesthetic purposes...you can get a good laugh by claiming Joja values its employees so little that even a Junior Vice-President only gets 10 microshares!

Also, my sprite work is kind of terrible, so the sprite for the item is kind of...crap. You're plenty welcome to replace it.

Manifest.Description: Grands a small severance package following your leaving Joja Corporation.
